topic: Practical Applications and Effects of Electromagnetic Waves
key_concepts: All EM waves travel at about 300 million m/s but differ in wavelength, frequency, and ener
Wavelength is inversely related to frequency and energy
Radio waves are used for radio/TV signals, GPS, and MRI
Microwaves are used for satellite communication, cellular phones, cooking, and RADAR
Microwave ovens heat food by agitating water molecules to create molecular friction
Infrared is used in remote controls, thermal imaging, and night vision goggles
Thermal imaging colors indicate temperature: blue/green colder, red/yellow warmer
Visible light enables sight, device screens, artificial lighting, and optical fibers/endos
Ultraviolet B converts skin protein 7-DHC into vitamin D3 for healthy bones and teeth
UV is used for security markings, water sterilization, and fluorescent whitening
X-rays diagnose bone fractures and short-wavelength X-rays penetrate metals for airport se
Gamma rays treat cancer through radiotherapy and sterilize surgical instruments
